name: Resampling Difference Histogram
description: An invisible acoustic scanner hunting for the echoes of forced resizing. When a fraudster hijacks a foreign object, scaling it up or shrinking it to fit the host canvas, the original pixel grid is synthetically fractured and mathematically padded. This forensic topographical tool interrogates the numerical 'difference' between adjacent pixels, ultimately capturing the mathematical screams of artificially stretched or compressed digital matter.
mechanism: By coldly subtracting the intensity of a neighboring pixel from the current one, the engine erects a Difference Histogram. In an unviolated, organic image, this graph slopes smoothly like a gentle hill. But the exact moment the geometry is upscaled or rotated, the graph brutally shatters into violent repeating structural voids (Valleys) interspersed with unnatural spikes (Peaks), definitively prosecuting the manipulator’s geometric forgery.
parameters: Differential Matrix: 1-Pixel N/S/E/W Variance, Wave Scanner: Periodicity Fluctuation Curve, Channel: Grayscale Intensity
accuracy: Solid (65-75%) - A highly specialized lethal antidote targeted strictly at perpetrators who sloppily resize or rotate elements within a composite.
source: Popescu & Farid (2005) - Interpolation Periodicity & Synthesization Traces
useCase: Brings the hammer of justice crashing down onto any subtle splice that bypasses the human eye but has suffered synthetic geometric resizing, violating the natural pixel-neighbor adjacency laws.

references.title: Popescu, A.C., & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing digital forgeries by detecting traces of resampling. IEEE TSP.
Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Krawetz, N. (2007). A Picture's Worth — Digital Image Analysis and Forensics.

strengths:
• A profoundly silent yet devastatingly fast execution weapon, digging the algorithmic graves of scaled forgeries without caring semantic meaning.
• Computationally executes verdicts in less than a second due to strictly reliant single-layer linear variation dynamics.
limitations:
• The forensic blade harmlessly deflects if a hyper-aware deep-editor deploys sophisticated Micro-Noise Dithering immediately post-resizing natively masking all mathematical empty valleys.
• Actively blinded and rendered paralyzed if the file is brutally crushed by Whatsapp/Facebook social media compression, effectively washing away the delicate linear gradient footprints.
